scope: current instructor-only and post-run debrief authority boundaries across supported campaign contracts

source_contract.stabilization_instructor_marker: src/debrief/report.rs: === INSTRUCTOR RUN SUMMARY & DECISION QUALITY REVIEW ===

stabilization-v1.player_observation: Reported metrics, committed history, and decision-time rationale remain the player-facing contract.
stabilization-v1.post_run_detail: The existing CLI instructor appendix may distinguish reported metrics from true underlying states for post-run review.
stabilization-v1.authority: Host/core debrief functions own the appendix; it is not a browser route or player command surface.

competitive-regional-v1.player_observation: Lagged/public rival information and committed player history remain the actor-visible contract.
competitive-regional-v1.post_run_detail: The existing competitive instructor summary may reveal unobserved rival actions and rationales after play.
competitive-regional-v1.authority: Host/core debrief functions own post-run instructor detail; the browser renders supplied text and cannot author outcomes.

regional-affiliation-v1.player_observation: Affiliation observations, committed transition summaries, and written stage/debrief text remain actor-visible; resolved inputs are not live controls.
regional-affiliation-v1.post_run_detail: Typed replay and CLI terminal debrief may retain post-resolution partner/stakeholder response detail under the existing contract.
regional-affiliation-v1.authority: No separate regional-affiliation instructor surface or browser true-state route is implemented or claimed.

presentation_surface.host_ownership: Host/core contracts own observation, resolution, debrief, and any post-run instructor detail; presentation is read-only.
presentation_surface.shared_rendering: Shared campaign/end-session renderers display supplied text, history, hashes, and debrief lines without authoring true state or outcomes.
presentation_surface.live_gui_boundary: The current live GUI exposes the shared campaign-coverage panel; no browser-native stabilization or regional-affiliation instructor route is claimed.
presentation_surface.written_fallback: Labels, source attribution, committed history, hashes, debrief text, and authority notices remain readable without audio or visual decoration.
